_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description. github_repo overrides which repository is queried for stars/forks.

projects.description: ESP32-based IoT motion-control system using MPU6050 + BLE HID. Achieves <10ms BLE latency as a fully wireless mouse. Open-source hardware and firmware.
Reverse-engineered GNSS receiver board centered on the u-blox NEO-M9N module with RF matching, power path, and KiCad PCB layout.
Standalone ESP8266 breakout board designed for embedded development with accessible GPIO, power and programming interfaces.
MP3 tag editing application for managing and modifying metadata embedded in audio files.
